q.line: And like we were hummingbirds screaming at ravens
stanza: We fell asleep in the back of the warehouse
I woke to you kneading and covering my mouth
And like we were hummingbirds screaming at ravens
You started to move me from fact into fable

q.line: My love, she's like some raven
